_comment: Pre-registered thresholds for the held-out family (Serilog), by stratum, committed before the held-out run. A run whose figures fall below a minimum or above a maximum is a registered miss, published as a miss -- not a reason to relax this file.

framework-f1.note: a lower recall floor is expected: the held-out family is not guaranteed to multi-target every Framework profile, and a narrower-than-hoped breadth is a published gap, not a blocker
